changelog: Call Coach: when a call connects and Coach comes forward by itself, the Preview & Publish workspace waits for THAT call (a bar says it is still live) and switches to it once its notes save, instead of showing the caller before.
New option (Options -> Coach & Sales, off by default): open the workspace only when a call connects, not every time you click over to Coach.
New option (Options -> Address Search Actions, off by default): the Go button also brings Preview & Publish into the address tab group with Roofr, Google Earth and Gemini.
